description: This file implements a factory for creating an E1 network server with SCTP integration, including notifiers for E1AP message forwarding between CU-CP and SCTP gateway, and manages SCTP server lifecycle.

classes.name: e1_to_gw_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for forwarding E1AP Tx PDUs from CU-CP to SCTP gateway.

classes.name: gw_to_e1_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for forwarding E1AP Rx PDUs from SCTP gateway to CU-CP.

classes.name: e1_sctp_server
classes.description: SCTP server implementation that manages E1 interface connections for CU-CP.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Handles new E1AP messages, packs and forwards them via SCTP.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SCTP SDUs, unpacks and forwards to CU-CP.

methods.name: attach_cu_cp
methods.description: Attaches CU-CP handler and starts listening for SCTP connections.

methods.name: get_listen_port
methods.description: Returns the listening port of the SCTP server.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new SCTP association notifier with integrated E1AP message handling.
